notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Dragons and/or Illusions.
description:
Cast Haze of Rage with buyback by paying {3}{R}.
Birgi, Manaform Hellkite and Haze of Rage's storm ability trigger.
Resolve the Birgi trigger, adding {R}.
Resolve the Manaform Hellkite trigger, creating a 5/5 Dragon Illusion creature token with haste.
The Dragon Illusion enters the battlefield, triggering Mana Echoes, adding at least {C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Haze of Rage trigger, creating a copy of it for each spell cast before it this turn.
Resolve each copy of Haze of Rage, giving your creatures +1/+0 until end of turn for each copy.
Resolve the original Haze of Rage, giving your creatures +1/+0 until end of turn and returning Haze of Rage to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.name: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty
